checks:
∀ (X : Type) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (a : ℝ) (A : Set X),
  MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a A =
    ⨆ (r : ℝ≥0∞) (_ : 0 < r), BasisObjects.content a r A

∀ (X : Type) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (A : Set X) (d : ℝ≥0),
  (((d : ℝ≥0∞) < dimH A) → MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (d : ℝ) A = ⊤) ∧
  ((dimH A < (d : ℝ≥0∞)) → MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (d : ℝ) A = 0) ∧
  ((MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (d : ℝ) A ≠ ⊤) → dimH A ≤ (d : ℝ≥0∞)) ∧
  ((MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (d : ℝ) A = ⊤) → (d : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ dimH A)
∀ (X : Type) [EMetricSpace X] (A B : Set X), A ⊆ B → dimH A ≤ dimH B

∀ (X : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X],
  dimH (Set.univ : Set X) = (Module.finrank ℝ X : ℝ≥0∞)

∀ (X Y : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
  [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] (e : X ≃L[ℝ] Y) (A : Set X),
  dimH (e '' A) = dimH A

∀ (X Y : Type) [EMetricSpace X] [EMetricSpace Y] (f : X → Y),
  Isometry f → ∀ A : Set X, dimH (f '' A) = dimH A
∀ a b : ℝ, MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Icc a b) = ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)

∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (f : ℕ → X → ℝ≥0∞),
  (∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ) →
  (∫⁻ x, ∑' i, f i x ∂μ) = ∑' i, ∫⁻ x, f i x ∂μ

∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (f g : X → ℝ≥0∞),
  (∀ x, f x ≤ g x) → (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ

∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (S : Set X) (c : ℝ≥0∞),
  MeasurableSet S → (∫⁻ x, S.indicator (fun _ => c) x ∂μ) = c * μ S

∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (BasisObjects.Rn n × ℝ)),
  dimH (BasisObjects.euclideanLift n '' S) = dimH S

∀ (X : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [FiniteDimensional ℝ X]
  (A : Set X), (interior A).Nonempty → dimH A = (Module.finrank ℝ X : ℝ≥0∞)
